title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
abstract: arXiv:2611.14210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. translated_title: Tree-Ising：利用比特级Ising编辑修复语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14210v1 公告类型：新 摘要：权重空间编程由Takehi等人近期在MIT的工作中提出，使前沿的LLM智能体能够读取网络的权重并编写修复方案。他们的GPT-6 Astra智能体在没有梯度的情况下纠正了Qwen3.5-0.8B的推理循环，共使用了158个智能体回合、8970万个token和50次前向传播请求。我们的方法Tree-Ising将这种修复表述为模型自身BF16权重上的稀疏离散优化问题。前向统计定义了一个目标函数，该函数能够削弱循环方向、增强结论方向，并在有效token上保持该层的输出。在状态树表示中（无损BF16存储作为其中的一个特例），可允许的编辑是保持所有共享组指数和尾数的符号翻转和指数移位。我们将该目标函数精确分解为独立的QUBO（Ising）问题，每个输出行一个，并在GPU上使用模拟退火或量子（原文在此处截断）方法求解。
tldr: Tree-Ising将语言模型的无梯度权重修复转化为BF16权重上的稀疏离散优化问题，通过符号翻转和指数移位等比特级编辑，将目标函数精确分解为逐输出行的QUBO/Ising问题，并在GPU上用模拟退火或量子方法求解，以修复模型推理循环等缺陷。
en_tdlr: Tree-Ising formulates gradient-free LLM weight repair as sparse discrete optimization over BF16 weights, using bit-level sign flips and exponent shifts to exactly decompose the objective into per-row QUBO (Ising) problems solved on GPUs via simulated annealing or quantum methods, thereby repairing defects such as reasoning loops.
